# Figure 1. Resuscitation


{{< include ../../_extensions/gaospecial/fig-export/_setup.qmd >}}

{{< include _theme-setup.qmd >}}


```{r}
#| label: setup
# ============================================================
# Figure 1 — 9 panels (A-I)
# 数据来源: analysis/amplicon/ 下的 lanc 系列分析
# ============================================================

setwd(here::here())

library(tidyverse)
library(microeco)
library(magrittr)
library(ape)
library(phangorn)
library(sf)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)

# --- 共享数据加载（lanc） ---
otu_table <- read.csv("data/processed/amplicon-sequencing/lanc/otu_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1)
sample_table <- read.csv("data/processed/amplicon-sequencing/lanc/sample_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1) |>
    mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("soil", "OC", "RC")))
taxon_table <- read.csv("data/processed/amplicon-sequencing/lanc/taxon_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1)

mt <- microtable$new(otu_table = otu_table, sample_table = sample_table, tax_table = taxon_table)
mt$tax_table <- subset(mt$tax_table, !is.na(Phylum))
mt$tax_table$Genus[mt$tax_table$Genus == "g__Burkholderia-Caballeronia-Paraburkholderia"] <- "g__Burkholderia"
mt$sample_table$place <- gsub("^GCA", "GCZ", mt$sample_table$place)
mt$sample_table <- base::subset(mt$sample_table, !grepl("^E", place))
mt$sample_table$type <- factor(mt$sample_table$type, levels = c("soil", "OC", "RC"))
mt$otu_table <- mt$otu_table[, rownames(mt$sample_table)]
mt$tidy_dataset()

# --- 共享数据加载（含系统发育树，用于 UniFrac） ---
tree_file <- "data/processed/amplicon-sequencing/lanc/asv.tree"
lanc_tree <- read.tree(tree_file)
tips_keep <- intersect(lanc_tree$tip.label, rownames(otu_table))
lanc_tree <- keep.tip(lanc_tree, tips_keep)
mt_tree <- microtable$new(
  otu_table = otu_table,
  sample_table = sample_table,
  tax_table = taxon_table,
  phylo_tree = lanc_tree
)
mt_tree$tidy_dataset()
```

### Panel A：采样地图

```{r}
#| label: fig1-a-map
#| fig-cap: "(A) 采样点分布图"
sample_info <- read.csv("data/processed/amplicon-sequencing/lanc/sample_table.csv",
                        col.names = c("sample", "type", "place", "location", "coords"))
unique_points <- sample_info |>
  distinct(place, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    lon = as.numeric(sub(",.*", "", coords)),
    lat = as.numeric(sub(".*,", "", coords))
  )

china_provinces <- st_read("data/prep/map/china_provinces.geojson")
china_national <- st_read("data/prep/map/china.json")

f1a = ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = china_provinces, fill = "gray98", color = "lightgrey") +
  geom_sf(data = china_national, fill = NA, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = unique_points, aes(x = lon, y = lat), color = "#e41a1c", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm")) 
f1a
```

### Panel B：群落结构（条形图）

```{r}
#| label: fig1-b-barplot
#| fig-cap: "(B) 属水平群落结构（按样本类型分面）"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 3
t1 <- trans_abund$new(dataset = mt, taxrank = "Genus", ntaxa = 8)
mt$sample_table$type <- fct_relevel(mt$sample_table$type, "soil", "OC", "RC")
f1b = t1$plot_bar(others_color = "grey70",
            facet = "type",
            xtext_keep = FALSE,
            legend_text_italic = TRUE) + theme_pub()
f1b
```

### Panel C：Alpha 多样性

```{r}
#| label: fig1-c-alpha
#| fig-cap: "(C) Alpha 多样性指数组间比较"
require(FSA); require(rcompanion)

measures <- c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson")
mt$cal_alphadiv(measures = measures)

# 1. 先设置因子顺序
mt$sample_table$type <- factor(mt$sample_table$type, levels = c("soil", "OC", "RC"))

# 2. 创建对象并计算差异
t1 <- trans_alpha$new(dataset = mt, group = "type")
t1$cal_diff(method = "KW_dunn", KW_dunn_letter = TRUE)

# 3. 【关键修复】强制 res_diff 的 Group 列顺序与样本表一致
desired_levels <- levels(mt$sample_table$type)
t1$res_diff$Group <- factor(t1$res_diff$Group, levels = desired_levels)
t1$res_diff <- t1$res_diff[order(t1$res_diff$Group), ]
rownames(t1$res_diff) <- NULL

# 4. 绘图
plots <- lapply(measures, function(x) {
  t1$plot_alpha(measure = x, add = "jitter", point_size = 1) + 
    theme_pub() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
})

f1c <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = 4, align = "hv")
f1c
```

### Panel D：Beta 多样性 — Weighted UniFrac PCoA

```{r}
#| label: fig1-d-beta
#| fig-cap: "(D) Beta 多样性：Weighted UniFrac PCoA"
mt_tree$cal_betadiv(unifrac = TRUE)

t1 <- trans_beta$new(dataset = mt_tree, group = "type", measure = "wei_unifrac")
t1$cal_ordination(method = "PCoA")

f1d = t1$plot_ordination(plot_color = "type", plot_type = c("point", "ellipse"), point_size = 1) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
f1d
```

### Panel E：Heatmap

```{r}
#| label: fig1-e-heatmap
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 2.5
library(ggplotify)

t1 <- trans_abund$new(dataset = mt, taxrank = "Genus", ntaxa = 12)
f1e <- as.ggplot(function() {
  t1$plot_heatmap(
    group = "place",
    xtext_keep = TRUE,
    withmargin = FALSE,
    plot_breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10),
    pheatmap = TRUE,
    treeheight_row = 20,      # 行树宽度缩小
    treeheight_col = 15,      # 列树高度缩小   
    # 文字
    fontsize = 8,
    fontsize_row = 8,
    fontsize_col = 4, 
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    annotation_col = mt$sample_table[, "type", drop = FALSE],
    annotation_colors = list(type = c(soil = "#1B9E77", OC = "#D95F02", RC = "#7570B3"))
  )
})
f1e
```

### Panel F：ASV 差异分析（LEfSe）

```{r}
#| label: fig1-f-diff
#| fig-cap: "(F) ASV 差异分析（LEfSe）"
# 克隆 mt 避免干扰其他面板
mt_diff <- clone(mt)
mt_diff$cal_abund()
mt_diff$taxa_abund$Genus <- mt_diff$taxa_abund$Genus[rowMeans(mt_diff$taxa_abund$Genus) > 0.01, ]
mt_diff$tidy_dataset()

t1 <- trans_diff$new(dataset = mt_diff, method = "lefse", group = "type", alpha = 0.01, taxa_level = "Genus")
f1f = t1$plot_diff_abund(plot_type = "errorbar", 
        keep_prefix = FALSE,
        point_size = 1.5,
        linewidth = 1,
        xtext_size = 8,
        ytitle_size = 9) +
          theme(legend.position = "none")
f1f
```

提取数据自己画。

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

```

```{r}
#| label: fig1-combine
#| fig-cap: "图 1 组合图（A–I 面板）"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
# ============================================================
# Figure 1 保存
# ============================================================
library(cowplot)
plot_grid(
  plot_grid(f1a, f1b, rel_widths = c(2,4), align = "hv", labels = LETTERS[1:2]),
  plot_grid(plots[[1]], plots[[2]], plots[[3]], plots[[4]], f1d, rel_widths = c(1,1,1,1,2), align = "hv", ncol = 5, labels = LETTERS[3:7]),
  plot_grid(f1e, f1f, rel_widths = c(4,2), align = "h", labels = LETTERS[8:9]),
  ncol = 1
)

```
